regions.label: Bank0BootstrapVectors

regions.label: DreamAnimationSelectorTable
regions.evidence: Eight-byte selector table read by indexed LDA $a14c,X at physical $212a. Source builds X from random low two bits and optionally OR $04; all eight records bound the exact table. LDA #0/STA/BPL unconditionally bypasses it. No natural selection completeness claim.

regions.label: ObjectSlotSelectorTable
regions.evidence: Four-byte selector table read by LDA $ae5f,X at physical $ee57 after AND #$03/TAX. Exact four-byte domain; downstream next routine begins $ae63. Static discovery branch-fallthrough ORA/BRK interpretation rejected by consumer and low-valued format.

regions.label: MotionPhaseSelectorTable
regions.evidence: Four-byte low-valued table read by LDA $da68,Y at physical $1dabf. BNE $dad1 immediately followed BEQ $da6c makes preceding fallthrough impossible regardless flags. Table ends at independently fetched $da6c entry; behavior meaning unresolved.
